intent: A gothic-lolita forest gown of black laced bodice, great pale moss bow and a deep tiered moss-green bell skirt ringed in lichen and bone, crowned with a moss bonnet overgrown by pale fungus caps, reading from the high camera as a green-and-black lady's shape over a wide ringed bell.
requests: A tapered skirt panel: a box can only step further out, so the bell is a staircase; a trapezoid part would let the tiers flare smoothly.
A soft cloth material whose edge catches the moon (velvet or moss), since nothing in the world shines and the ruffles must carry all their light in flat colour.
